name: Review & Reputation Monitor | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Review & Reputation Monitor
Every morning checks your Google Business reviews (Google Places API), finds the new ones, has the AI rate the sentiment and draft a public reply, logs them, emails you at once about low ratings, and sends a short digest.
Google returns the 5 most relevant reviews per check, so very busy places may miss some.
1. Fill in **Settings** (Place ID: Google's Place ID Finder). 2. Create a Header Auth credential: name `X-Goog-Api-Key`, value = a Google Cloud API key with the Places API (New) enabled. 3. Make a sheet with a **Reviews** tab (`reviews-sheet.csv`). 4. Connect OpenAI, Google Sheets and Gmail. 5. Activate.
